laws.rule: Bogotá's Decreto 293 of 26 June 2025 sets selling and drinking hours for alcohol: general venues 10:00 am to 11:59 pm; bars and nightclubs 10:00 am to 3:00 am the next day, or to 5:00 am in the 'focused zones' the city was to define. The hours do not cover deliveries to a private home. The decree also bars drinking alcohol in public space within 200 metres of an educational centre. Bogotá also declares dry days (ley seca) by decree for elections, for example Decreto 191 of 2026 for the 31 May 2026 vote, which applies to visitors as well as residents.
